rule: Advance only after applicable prerequisite evidence is recorded and independent review has no unresolved blocking findings. A coherent intermediate commit does not mark a milestone complete.

exit_checks: All exact source anchors and schema-column references resolve
Collection cardinality, ordering, applicability and knowledge-state addressing reviewed substantively
DDL plus positive/negative contract examples execute
Both declared pilot projects build; exact Clang/MSVC context and Roslyn operation oracles verified
All 24 gold questions and 360-trial protocol fixed before product outputs
Known design blockers corrected and independently rechecked

commit_units.scope: Implement typed contracts, exact source archive, deterministic IDs, context capture and canonical validation
Roslyn and native Clang pilot adapters with exact declared entity/operation outputs
Pilot branch CFG and intraprocedural scalar reaching definitions with evidence and uncertainty
Uncapped P1-P4 projections, minimal anchors, immutable publishing and bounded scoped queries
Full pilot conformance, all scheduled AI trials and size/cost report; define later performance thresholds

exit_checks: Both languages through one canonical dataset and all four exports
Exact pilot identity/operation/CFG/data-flow facts pass
Source fidelity and encoding cases pass
Retained semantic equivalence and reference integrity pass
Omitted detail unavailable; no hidden canonical reads
Re-export does not rerun analysis
Failure and publication checks pass
24x5x3 trial accounting with actual usage and fixed budgets; failed trials remain visible
First size/quality/cost report and independent review

commit_units: Coral and CppSharp declared-scope feature/region coverage
exit_checks: Every declared M2 feature passes exact fixtures
Reconciled multi-TU and multi-assembly identity/context isolation
Capture identities and retained nonoptional fields survive all profiles
Root visibility, deduplicated group counts and logical/physical separation
Both pinned real resources exercised with per-feature/region coverage and all unsupported requirements disclosed
Benchmark rerun where added capabilities affect questions
prohibited_before_exit: claiming full target support from source-row counts alone

commit_units: data-flow families and indirect call candidates
explicit-root reachability with witnesses and unknown boundaries
exit_checks: Every declared operation/analysis family passes positive and absence fixtures
May/must, external effects, alias uncertainty and candidate completeness preserved
All independent optional-section selection/budget boundaries pass
Whole units, canonical serializer byte counts and omission reasons reproducible
No dead-code or observed-runtime claims inferred improperly

commit_units: observed execution/log ingestion and reuse states
exit_checks: Declared/evaluated/expected/observed/skipped/cache states pass fixtures
Existing output alone never proves production by a run
Observed durations and unresolved binary mappings preserve missing states
Generated source and artifact evidence links validate
No BDR application runtime collection introduced

commit_units: full conformance and final comparison report
exit_checks: All applicable fixture checks pass
Target-resource supported scope and required feature gates met
All omissions, failed/partial analyses and exclusions explained
Old snapshots/exports survive updates and failures
Measured thresholds established after M1 and before M5 pass
Profile recommendation is based on measured task/category/size tradeoffs

requirements: Preserve failed attempts and resolved history
Do not turn unknown/not_run into passed or zero
No silent scope reduction; document and verify adaptations

commit_policy.body: Purpose, actual validation and material limits; focus on one coherent task.
commit_policy.publication: Read head, preserve tree, guarded non-force update, fetch/readback and compare local staged tree. Current HTTPS push authentication failure uses verified GitHub API alternative.
